name: Lying Leg Curl
validation_note: Bands are the standard coaching ranges for this movement, not measured against a labelled clip. Treat a fix verdict as a prompt to look, not as a measured fault.

start_cue.en: Set up on the machine and move through the full range.
start_cue.hi: Machine par set ho, poora range cover karo.

good.en: Good. You moved through the full range.
good.hi: Badhiya. Aapne poora range cover kiya.

below.en: That is far enough. Do not force more.
below.hi: Itna hi kaafi hai. Zyada zor mat lagao.

fix.en: Finish the movement before you come back.
fix.hi: Wapas aane se pehle movement poora karo.

almost.en: Finish the movement before you come back.
almost.hi: Wapas aane se pehle movement poora karo.

fix.en: Too fast. Control the way back. Count 2 seconds.
fix.hi: Bahut tez hai. Wapas aane mein control rakho. 2 tak gino.

above.en: Very slow. Good control — keep moving smoothly.
above.hi: Bahut slow hai. Control achha hai, smooth chalte raho.

below.en: Too fast. Control the way back. Count 2 seconds.
below.hi: Bahut tez hai. Wapas aane mein control rakho. 2 tak gino.

almost.en: A bit fast. Count 2 seconds on the way down.
almost.hi: Thoda tez hai. Neeche aate time 2 tak gino.
